Just for fun

Denon DN-SC2000 · Traktor Pro 4

A mapping and setup workflow for my two Denon controllers.

Denon DN-SC2000Traktor Pro 4MIDI · v5.1.0

The task

Make my two-controller DJ setup dependable and repeatable.

The approach

One TSI combines Deck A/B, FX and LED feedback. Loop length and Beatjump size remain independent.

In use

Version 5.1.0 validated by me with both Denons. The DJ TechTools listing still carries its earlier release-candidate note.

Workflow

  1. Identify each controller and its MIDI channel with Monitor.
  2. Assign verified input/output ports; disable duplicate mappings.
  3. Keep USB connections consistent and check again after moving them.

My Windows / Traktor Pro 4 setup. Other configurations unverified.
